uncertainties: Six host answers are labelled substitutions, each recorded so the log names them: the turning-gun class test (0095EC46), 00729F10's three operational flags (0095EC52), the ready-round timers 00727D70 counts (0095EC84, every barrel counts as ready), the ammunition cycle period (0095EE07, the gun's reload time stands in for [ammo+2Ch]), the four allow bytes, and the four target fields of the query block. Each is a place where the rating is optimistic rather than wrong in form.
blast_damage_min (+B4h) is the one projectile field the gunnery host does not carry, so it stays zero.

The hit probability uses the 00836EF0 default profile. Because all twenty of its slots are 0.5f the answer does not depend on 008386F0's unread interpolation, but it will the moment the authored table is loaded.

00956C20 itself was not re-read for this packet; its rule is taken from docs/GUNNERY_TABLES.md, which read it whole, and the value is consumed through the gunnery host's existing binding of it rather than reimplemented.
